description_en: Efficiently detects and recognizes Korean printed text in Korean image document scenarios, and supports multiple basic features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
description_zh: 针对韩语图片文档场景下韩文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-korean --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/dgzqnh/%E9%9F%A9%E8%AF%AD%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --output-char-info false --need-rotate false --output-table false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeKorean

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2 048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size. Either this or the URL parameter must be provided. When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output per-character recognition results
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出单字识别结果
parameters.name: output_char_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. Rotation is automatically applied in structured detection, mixed-layout scenarios, and education-related scenarios, so this parameter does not need to be set in those cases. The response includes angle information.
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要自动旋转功能（结构化检测、混贴场景、教育相关场景会自动做旋转，无需设置），返回角度信息
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息
parameters.name: output_table

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
